results.title: 75-year-old with Parkinson’s and life-threatening heart rhythm disorder undergoes simultaneous brain and heart implant surgery in Bengaluru
results.description: In a groundbreaking procedure in Bengaluru, a 75-year-old man underwent simultaneous deep brain stimulation (DBS) surgery along with the installation of a leadless pacemaker. This unique approach tackled both his Parkinson's disease and a severe heart rhythm disorder. By integrating these two intricate surgeries, doctors minimized risks tied to dual implants, leading to marked improvements in the patient's movement and cardiovascular health after just one session.
